analysis: Reviewed the three changed files. (1) ClusterSetupWizardCommand.swift: runOnboarding (line 116) now calls requireNewPairApproval before building settings or starting the onboarding. The new FeatureWaitlistGate is a client-side CLI check on the owner's own Mac. `cluster local` (localOnly scope) and already-paired Macs skip it (lines 154-159). Coordinator-side authorization stays platform-owned, so this client gate cannot be a trust control against ADV-001 and I treat it as UX/policy only. It does not alter the provider's WebSocket, attestation, App Attest, or serving-authorization paths (TB-002, TB-009, TB-011), and it adds no new key, token, or prompt handling. The `.live(configPath:)` access path presumably reads the account token (A-008) to ask the coordinator about the waitlist. Its implementation (FeatureWaitlistAccess, FeatureWaitlistGate) is not in the supplied evidence. A next pass should check that it sends the token only to the issuer-bound coordinator URL, honors the token/issuer binding noted for A-008, and fails open or closed as intended (the comment says an unreadable pairing state is never asked). (2) Darkbloom.swift line 60 registers a new `Waitlist.self` subcommand. Its source is not supplied, so its network, token and input handling are unverified and need review. (3) SandboxCommand.swift is help text only: it mentions `waitlist sandbox`. TB-013/T-061 behavior (installer download and run) is unchanged in the supplied diff, and a sandbox-setup gate, if any, lives elsewhere. No concrete regression is identifiable from the supplied lines. needs_deeper_review is set because the new Waitlist command and the FeatureWaitlist* types are outside the supplied evidence.
